cuando.aproximada: The date we show is approximate.

repite: Town festivals repeat every year, but the dates can move by a few days. Before you go, confirm with the town hall, the parish or the organizers.
esperar: Colima's town festivals usually combine Mass and processions, music and dancing, food stalls and street snacks, fairground rides and, depending on each town's tradition, horseback parades or rodeos. They are a good chance to learn about local customs and try local food.
consejos: Bring cash in small bills and coins: almost nobody at the stalls takes cards.
Arrive early and look for parking: on the main days of the festival, downtown streets are closed or packed.
Wear comfortable clothes and shoes and protect yourself from the sun; it can cool down at night.
Respect the religious celebrations and look after your belongings in the crowd.
